Tamil Virtual University (TVU) was established by the Government of Tamil Nadu on 18th May 2000. This academy is functioning under the administrative control of the Information Technology Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The TVU was renamed as Tamil Virtual Academy (TVA) with effect from 16th July 2010. t: Puraththinai War Related Flowers in Sangam Literature
